dedupe_keys.name: hydro quebec hourly substation consumption of customers in a local demand response programme montreal with thermostat and weather data

description: Hydro-Québec publishes on its open data portal, read on 2026-09-26, an anonymised dataset of the electricity use of customers who take part in a local demand response programme in the Montréal region. Hourly records per substation combine consumption aggregated from Hydro-Québec smart meters, average indoor temperature and thermostat setpoint from Hilo smart thermostats, the number of connected customers and thermostats, flags for demand response events, calendar data, and weather: air temperature, wind speed, solar irradiance, relative humidity and snowfall. The dataset holds 64,605 rows and was last modified on 27 November 2024. It is free under CC BY-NC 4.0, which rules out commercial use. Caveats: only participating customers are included, so results do not represent all load on each substation, and updates appear to have stopped in 2024. Simulation uses are modelling peak demand reduction and thermostat behaviour for agent-based demand response studies and capacity planning in a winter-peaking system. Related records: data-pecan-street-dataport offers residential submetered data from the United States.
